title: Can an evidence map beat a cited memo?

memo.title: Agent Skills vs MCP memo
paragraphs: Current position. Default to an Agent Skill for reusable procedure and bundled context. Add MCP for live or dynamic tools and resources; combine them when the Skill should orchestrate an MCP-backed capability.

The Skill boundary packages instructions, examples, references, assets, and scripts with progressive disclosure [S1]. GitHub documents that open format across Copilot clients [S2], although there is still no standard way to ask what skills a domain publishes [S3].

MCP addresses a different boundary: servers expose tools for AI actions, resources for context data, and prompts for interaction templates [S4]. This makes MCP appropriate for dynamic capability, but it also introduces authorization and operational risks documented by the protocol's security guidance [S5].

The formats can therefore compose. A Skill can teach a repeatable workflow while an MCP server supplies live data or actions. Choosing a Skill is not a safety shortcut because Skills may include executable scripts and host permission behavior varies.
The most important unknown is behavioral portability. No committed cross-client benchmark yet shows that one non-trivial Skill and MCP integration behave consistently across major coding agents.

memo.title: Zero-dependency core memo
paragraphs: Current position. Keep the validator, renderer, installer, and Action on Node built-ins until a measured workflow justifies adding a dependency.
This is already part of the contributor contract: Doubt is defined as a zero-dependency Node CLI and portable Agent Skill, with a local-first and provider-independent core [S1].

The current implementation is not merely aspirational. Its evidence-contract suite passes all twenty committed structural and rendering mutations [S2]. That result is qualified: the same report says it does not measure source truth or faithful extraction.

The strongest counterpressure is maintenance. The repository owns its document layout, styling, graph drawing, filtering, and source-panel interaction inside the built-in renderer [S3]. A dependency might eventually replace a meaningful part of that surface.
The missing evidence is a threshold test: no observed user workflow yet shows that a dependency removes enough complexity to offset installation and supply-chain cost.

memo.title: Distribution-surface memo
paragraphs: Current position. Keep the Agent Skill and deterministic CLI as two surfaces of one evidence contract.

The Agent Skill supplies the judgment workflow: it tells the agent to preserve disagreement and bounded source regions when a consequential question has competing claims [S1]. The CLI supplies the reproducible executable surface; the package exposes a doubt binary and publishes the skill payload with the implementation [S2].

The strongest counterpressure is premature format maintenance. Doubt also emits a version 0.2 discovery index and root-level portable skill archive [S3], but adoption of that emerging discovery route has not been demonstrated.
Dual distribution is qualified by contract unity. The surfaces are useful only while they enforce the same schema and do not make different product claims.
The missing evidence is observed retention: without telemetry or a user sample, it is unknown whether people keep the skill, CLI, both, or neither.

memo.title: Source-region policy memo
paragraphs: Current position. Keep exact locators and bounded excerpts as a fail-closed requirement, while describing the guarantee as traceability rather than truth.

The validator requires valid publication and retrieval dates, a safe URL or local path, a bounded locator, and a substantive excerpt [S1]. Deterministic mutations cover malformed dates, unbounded locators, and invalid excerpts [S2].
The strongest counterpressure is overinterpretation. Public documentation explicitly says the suite does not establish whether a source is true or whether an AI extracted it faithfully [S3].
The rule is therefore qualified: a well-bounded quotation can still be misleading, stale, or unrelated to the reasoning edge attached to it.
The most important missing evidence is entailment. Doubt does not yet deterministically establish that the bounded excerpt supports the evidence text and edge note.

memo.title: Sharing-artifact memo
paragraphs: Current position. Keep self-contained HTML as the default portable artifact and treat hosted collaboration as an optional future layer.

The renderer already produces one interactive file that can be opened locally, stored in git, or published without an account, backend, model key, CDN, or telemetry [S1]. The public workflow deploys the map, JSON, and discovery payload as one static Pages artifact [S2].
The document still provides interaction: its built-in script selects exact source regions, filters card types, and redraws graph connections [S3].
The strongest counterpressure is collaboration. A static file has no shared editing state, permission model, or synchronized review comments.

Static-first is qualified rather than absolute: a hosted layer may be useful later, but the durable artifact should remain independent. The missing evidence is a team study comparing collaboration demand with account-free portability.
